verification.note: Every price cell is UNVERIFIED or blank: no official or licensed source publishes betting prices (Q-02). Closing numbers are recorded from a fingerprinted third-party mirror so the CLV machinery has a placeholder; opening numbers are blank because nothing records them. CLV columns stay blank until a verified feed is attached.
